{{Quote|You know some of the important members of the Rebellion? The heroes?|Sami, to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Meow" />}}
'''Sami''' was a [[Cantrosian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and member of a Cantrosian [[Minka's faction|faction]] loyal to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], they became involved in a conspiracy in their [[Cantros system/Legends|home system]] and fought alongside the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|heroes of the Rebellion]] against a suspected [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Niru's faction|cell]]. Sami learned that one of their closest allies, [[Durne]], was manipulating the situation, and that their supposed enemies were in fact loyal to the Rebellion. After the traitor was arrested, Sami and their companion [[Minka]] sought to repair relations among their people and find a common ground with them.

==Biography==
===Trouble in the Cantros system===
{{Quote|There is not now, nor has there ever been any Imperial activity in this sector.''"<br />"''Then why do more of our people turn up dead every day? Who sends the ships against us?|Han Solo and Sami discuss the conflict in the Cantros system|<ref name="Meow" />}}
[[File:Ohsnap.jpg|thumb|left|210px|Sami and Han Solo, both shocked to discover the allegiance of their captors]]
A [[Cantrosian]]<ref name="CN2" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]], Sami was born in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the<ref name="Meow" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Cantros system/Legends|Cantros system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Cantros 7]]. They were part of a Cantrosian [[Minka's faction|faction]] loyal to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], and worked with fellow fighters [[Minka]] and intelligence coordinator [[Durne]]. Based on Durne's intelligence, Sami and the others in their faction came to believe that an opposing [[Niru's faction|Cantrosian faction]] was loyal to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and was taking orders from [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] himself.<ref name="Meow" />

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">"[[The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs]]" describes the events in the [[Cantros system/Legends|Cantros system]] as occurring several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places in the first half of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> Sami was stationed on an [[Cantrosian asteroid base|asteroid base]] in the [[Cantros system/Legends|Cantros system]] when Minka set out to reach the nearest Rebel base and seek aid; however, she was attacked by [[BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] from the opposing faction. Her [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] was shot down on the planet [[Saijo/Legends|Saijo]], but she was rescued by [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Rebel heroes]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Minka then brought the heroes back to the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] base and introduced them to Sami and Durne. The Rebels informed the Cantrosians that there was no Imperial activity in the Cantros [[Star system/Legends|system]], nor had there ever been, causing Sami to question who they were fighting. Durne insisted that the reports from his intelligence network should be trusted, but Solo suggested that the Rebels investigate the opposing faction. Sami and Minka then joined them in traveling aboard Solo's [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|starship]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], to the [[Niru's base|base]] of the supposedly Imperial faction on a nearby planet.<ref name="Meow" />

===A traitor exposed===
{{Quote|Whatever comes, let's bear it with honor! We die, if need be, for the sake of the Rebellion!|Sami, to Han Solo and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Meow" />}}
[[File:SamiNSolo.jpg|thumb|right|210px|Sami and Solo reveal their allegiance.]]
While aboard the ''Falcon'' with Minka, Sami keenly questioned Skywalker and his companions about the activities of the Rebellion, although the Rebels did not reveal their own heroic status. The ''Falcon'' was then hit by enemy fire from more Cantrosian [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] and was forced to land in a gully on the rival faction's planet. Observing that the sides of the fissure were too steep to climb, Sami was amazed as Skywalker used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|levitate]] Organa and Minka to safety. The local faction, led by the Cantrosian [[Niru]], converged on the gully, and Sami was captured along with Skywalker and Solo. Sami was shocked when they discovered that their captors were Rebels and joined Solo in assertively declaring their allegiance.<ref name="Meow" />

Sami's shock turned to anger when Durne appeared, ordering Niru and her subordinates to [[Death/Legends|kill]] their captives, declaring them to be Imperial sympathizers. Durne was manipulating the situation, having been hired<ref name="Meow" /> by [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Ozrei N'takkilomandrife|Knife]]<ref name="HSref">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/nagai11202009/index.html|text=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs|int=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs}}</ref> to sow distrust and internecine hostility among the Cantrosians by suggesting that some were allied with the Empire. The situation became an [[Skirmish in the Cantros system|all-out battle]] when Organa and Minka intervened; aware that both sides were allies, Sami told Minka to use the [[Stun/Legends|stun]] setting on her [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] as she leapt into the fray. Durne was captured and, with the tensions between the factions defused, Sami and Minka began interacting with the others in the Rebel cell, learning about each other and forming a mutual bond.<ref name="Meow" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Keep your blaster set to stun. No matter how misguided they may be, these people are still our allies!|Sami, to Minka|<ref name="Meow" />}}
Sami was a passionate supporter of the Rebel Alliance and espoused its ideals vehemently, even expressing his willingness to die for the cause. They also showed affection for Minka, referring to her as "darling" and often sitting or standing close to his companion and holding her. Sami had [[Color/Legends|orange]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], pale golden [[Hair/Legends|fur]], and curly hair of the same hue.<ref name="Meow" />

==Equipment==
Sami wore a purple [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]] and dark brown [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="Meow" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sami appeared in the [[Marvel Comics]] issue [[Star Wars (1977) 93|''Star Wars'' 93]],<ref name="Meow" /> which was published on [[December 18]], [[1984]].<ref name="Marvel">{{BookCite|title=[[Marvel Age]]|number=Vol. 1 No. 23|publisher=[[Marvel Comics]] Group|date=[[February]] [[1985]]}}</ref> The comic was written by [[Mary Jo Duffy]] and illustrated by [[Sal Buscema]].<ref name="Meow" />
